findings.title: Mock IssueOccurrence hardcodes ID and ignores value, masking mismatched test expectations
findings.body: `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` hardcodes `id="eb4b0acffadb4d098d48cb14165ab578"` and `event_id="43878ab4419f4ab181f6379ac376d5aa"` and never uses the `value` parameter. Because `IssueOccurrence` equality only compares `id` (and `event_data` only contains fields derived from those constants and the frozen timestamp), any two `(occurrence, event_data)` pairs produced during a test compare equal regardless of `group_key`, `value`, or `new_status`. This already hides several mismatches in this test file: in `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe` (lines 536-559), `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` is called with `group_key="val1", value=6` while `evaluate_group_key_value` is called with `group_key="group_key", value=10`; and in `test_state_results_multi_group` (line 191), `test_results_on_change` (line 490), and `TestEvaluate.test_dedupe` (line 510), `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` is called with `value=6` when the evaluated packet values are `10`, `100`, and `8`.
